messages:
tara: Quick flag from onboarding: sample READMEs have a few copy/paste traps causing runtime errors for new users. Spotted two today: RW_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY, and the Node JS snippet using a default import which breaks ESM consumers.
leo: Oof. That explains the "module not found" errors in the partner slack. Can you paste the offending Node snippet?
tara: Current README shows:
```js
import client from '@redwood/inference'
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' })
```
Which errors for ESM users and hides where the API key should be provided.
oliver: We should standardize on a minimal, copy-paste-friendly snippet that works for CommonJS and ESM and shows where to set REDWOOD_API_KEY. Proposal:
```js
// ESM/TS
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' })
```
```js
// CJS
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```
Also add a short curl example using "Bearer" prefix (not "Token").
tara: Also add a short PowerShell vs bash note for env var examples. New users keep pasting Windows syntax into bash and vice versa which causes lengthy support threads.
leo: I'll open a tiny docs PR that replaces the snippets, adds the env var examples, and includes a one-liner troubleshooting note about legacy RW_* keys. Anyone object to a quick patch to main?
oliver: No objections. Can we also run a docs grep for RW_API_KEY and Authorization: Token to catch other occurrences?
lint-bot: scheduled run: docs/grep for deprecated tokens and legacy env names.
doc-bot: Current file: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/samples/sample-app/README.md
leo: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 1 lines changed7 - updates snippets + adds PowerShell note. CI will validate.
lint-bot: docs-lint: snippet-check FAILED on refs/pull/912/head - found "Authorization: Token" at README.md:58.
tara: Good catch from lint. I'll update the curl example to use "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" and re-run.
leo: After merge, can we add a tiny docs-lint rule to error on RW_API_KEY and Token prefix? That should prevent regressions.
oliver: I'll draft the lint rule and a short unit test. Landing both today.
leo: Merged and published to docs site. Onboarding team notified. Closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
